{{main article|1991 WTA Tour}}

The [[WTA Tier I events]] are part of the elite tour for professional women's [[tennis]] organised by the [[Women's Tennis Association|WTA]] called the [[WTA Tour]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=1991 Tournaments {{!}} WTA Official |url=https://www.wtatennis.com/tournaments/1991 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://archive.today/20220920182800/https://www.wtatennis.com/tournaments/1991 |archive-date=2022-09-20 |access-date= |website=Women's Tennis Association |language=en}}</ref><ref name=wot1992>{{cite book|title=World of Tennis 1992|year=1992|publisher=CollinsWillow|location=London|isbn=9780002184304|pages=154, 152, 166, 167|editor=[[John Barrett (tennis)|John Barrett]]}}</ref>
